name: Darkvision
description: You have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet, as described in chapter 1.

name: Dwarven Resilience
description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

name: Dwarven Combat Training
description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, warhammer, and light hammer.

name: Stonecunning
description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus to the check.

name: Keen Senses
description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

name: Fey Ancestry
description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition.

name: Trance
description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a tranquil state, during which you retain consciousness.

name: Lucky
description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

name: Brave
description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the frightened condition.

name: Halfling Nimbleness
description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours, but you can't stop in the same space.

name: Draconic Ancestry
description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type, as shown in the table.

name: Breath Weapon
description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy associated with your draconic ancestry. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 damage, and on a successful save, it takes half as much damage. The damage type is determined by your draconic ancestry. Damage increases at higher levels. After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Damage Resistance (Draconic)
description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

name: Gnome Cunning
description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws you make against spells and other magical effects.

name: Menacing
description: You have proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

name: Relentless Endurance
description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Savage Attacks
description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

name: Hellish Resistance
description: You have resistance to fire damage.

name: Infernal Legacy
description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast the Hellish Rebuke spell as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th level you can cast the Darkness spell once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Unarmored Defense (Barbarian)
description: While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

name: Unarmored Defense (Monk)
description: While you are not wearing any armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

name: Rage
description: On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain the following benefits if you aren't wearing heavy armor: you have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, you deal 2 extra damage on melee weapon attacks that use Strength, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Your rage lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. It ends early if you are knocked unconscious or if your turn ends and you haven't attacked a hostile creature, taken damage, or been targeted with a damaging spell since your last turn.

name: Reckless Attack
description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly; doing so gives you advantage on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until then.

name: Danger Sense
description: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws you make against effects you can see, such as spells and traps, but not against effects you can't see, like a hidden attacker's critical hit.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll from a weapon that has the finesse or ranged property. The extra damage is 1d6, and it increases by 1d6 at certain levels. The attack must have advantage on the attack roll, or the attack must be against a creature within 5 feet of a creature other than you that is hostile to it.

name: Divine Sense
description: As an action, you can sense the presence of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet of you that aren't behind total cover. You sense their kinds but not their identities. Until the end of your next turn, you also sense whether there are any undead, fiends, or celestials within the same radius that are charmed or frightened by you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Lay on Hands
description: As a magic action, you can touch a creature and draw out its wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a long rest. With that pool, you can restore a number of hit points equal to your paladin level times 5. As an action, you can also spend a number of hit points from this pool to restore that many hit points to a creature you touch.

name: Wild Shape
description: As a magic action, you can assume the shape of a beast you have seen before. The kind of beast is determined by your druid level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short rest or long rest. Your game statistics are replaced by the beast's, but you retain your creature type, alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiency bonus, and senses. You can't cast spells while in Wild Shape, and your equipment melds into your new form.

name: Ki
description: You have a pool of ki points equal to your monk level. You can spend ki points to fuel certain class features, and you regain all expended ki points when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Martial Arts
description: Whenever you take the Attack action with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon on your turn, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action. You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes and monk weapons. Your unarmed strike damageDie progresses with your monk level (d4 at 1st, d6 at 5th, d8 at 11th, d10 at 17th).

name: Deflect Missiles
description: You can use your reaction to deflect or catch a missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your monk level.

name: Spellcasting
description: Each class that casts spells has a Spellcasting feature. The feature defines what spells you know/prepare, your spellcasting ability, the number of spell slots you have, the level of those slots, and the DC and attack bonus of your spells.

name: Fighting Style
description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Two-Weapon Fighting, or Unarmed Fighting. You can't take the same fighting style more than once, even if you later gain another feature that lets you choose a fighting style.

name: Second Wind
description: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

name: Action Surge
description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, in addition to the regular action you take. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

name: Indomitable
description: When you make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, you can reroll the die (you must use the new roll). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest at higher levels.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn (gained at 5th level by most classes). The number of attacks increases at higher levels.

name: Channel Divinity
description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two effects: Turn Undead (which turns undead creatures away) and an effect determined by your Divine Domain. Some uses of Channel Divinity are regained on a short rest, others on a long rest.

name: Divine Intervention
description: At 10th level, you can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great. Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action and speak a prayer. Your DM chooses the nature of the intervention; it could be a dramatic manifestation of your deity's presence, a visible sign of favor, or a miraculous event.

name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You learn magical abilities called Eldritch Invocations that augment your capabilities. You gain invocations at certain warlock levels and can swap them when you gain a warlock level.

name: Pact Magic
description: Your magic relies on patronage from a powerful entity. You have a number of pact magic spell slots equal to your warlock level, and all slots are the same level. You regain expended slots on a short or long rest.

name: Arcane Recovery
description: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The combined levels of the slots can't exceed half your wizard level (rounded up), and no single slot can be higher than 6th level.
